summary_en: Step introduced progressive dividends for fiscal years ending September 2027–2031, committing to maintain or increase annual per-share dividends year-on-year while targeting a 50% payout ratio. The current interim dividend was raised to 47 yen per share from a prior forecast of 44 yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Dividends and Changes to Dividend Policy (Introduction of Progressive Dividends)
translation_en_brief: Step announced a change to its dividend policy effective from the fiscal year ending September 2027, introducing progressive dividends for the five-year period through fiscal year ending September 2031. Under this new framework, the company commits to maintain or increase annual per-share dividends year-on-year while targeting a 50% payout ratio. The company cited its need to invest in management infrastructure transformation over the next five years, including school consolidation, equipment investment, system renewal, and human resource development in response to demographic decline and evolving business conditions in the 2030s. Despite expected single-year profit fluctuations during this transformation period due to upfront costs, the company intends to sustain stable dividend payments based on its solid financial foundation and stable business revenue. For the current fiscal year ending September 2026, the company increased the year-end dividend to 47 yen per share from a prior forecast of 44 yen, bringing the annual dividend to 91 yen per share compared to 85 yen in the previous fiscal year. After the five-year period concludes, the company will establish new shareholder return policies as part of its next medium-term business plan, taking into account business environment, profitability, financial condition, and growth investment requirements at that time.
